data.name: Bernadine
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Bernardus' meaning 'brave as a bear'. The feminine form Bernadine was derived and became popular during the Middle Ages as a devotional name in honor of St. Bernadine of Siena. With the meaning 'Bright as the dawn', it represents a hopeful, pure, and shining spirit.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and purity, shining bright like the dawn.
